channel.description: Occasional pieces by Reza Larimi on intelligence, hardware, founders and what he is learning.

item.title: A Kind No: Four Questions Before the Next Yes
item.description: You can care about people and still hold a hard standard. A one-minute check before the next yes: purpose, capacity, ownership, trade-off. Prompted by a Harvard Business Review piece on purpose-driven leadership.

item.title: Life Has No Stop Button: One Perspective on the AI Moment
item.description: AI is not artificial. It is evolution finding a new substrate. One perspective on the superintelligence moment, without telling you how to feel about it.
